items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: Well, I had one brother, as I know, Robert Burrett.

ctx.x: Well, as I was told, my mother said she brought me here when I was about two months old.
Yeah. Mm-hmm. And who else was in your family? You had any brothers and sisters? Well, I had one brother, as I know, Robert Burrett.
He died. He died. He died. I was away when he died. I don't know exactly what he is. He died here.
